title: 19 Ferry Green · Saturday second look
summary: Priya will meet you at the porch at the start of the open house so you can walk through before it gets busy.
body: Come to the green a few minutes before 1:00. We will start at the porch and take the house in the usual order, then step into the side yard. If you want a second pass without the crowd, we can wait until 3:00.

title: 14 Millrace Row · after the Green
summary: A private walk-through with Ned after you finish at Ferry Green, so you can compare a Reach cottage the same day.
body: Ned will meet you at 14 Millrace Row at 3:15. Park in the alley if the street is tight. Look at the back bedroom and the fence on the race; those are the two things that decide this house.

title: 6 Sash Lane · first-look notes
feedback: You liked the side porch and the walk to the landing, and you were right that the second bedroom was tight. The house went under contract the next day, which is useful context for 19 Ferry Green: porches that face a public green do not last.
summary: Your notes from the October showing at 6 Sash Lane, kept here because the house is now under contract.
body: These are the notes from your first showing on the Green. 6 Sash Lane is under contract now. 19 Ferry Green is the closer comparison for a porch and a walk, with a third bedroom.

title: 19 Ferry Green · agent debrief
feedback: Thirty-one groups through. Three serious conversations, including Mae Hollister. Nobody flinched at the price. One inspector-type asked about the easement; the survey is already in the packet.
summary: Desk debrief from the first Saturday open house at 19 Ferry Green.
body: Priya's count and the follow-ups are in the private file. Please do not quote attendance to other buyers.

title: 8 Lintel Street · Wednesday tour
summary: Broker tour for the coming foursquare on Lintel Street. Agents only; no unannounced buyers.
body: Sign in on the porch sheet. Evan will be there for the first hour. If you have a buyer who needs a look the same day, call first.
